# Running the demo

```{r, include = FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(
  collapse = TRUE,
  comment = "#>",
  eval = FALSE
)
```

The public PBMC demo runs the `immune_human_2x` aggregation through every configured review checkpoint. Run this from a repository-root R session after completing [Installation](installation.qmd).

```{.r filename="R"}
targets::tar_make(tidyselect::matches("immune_human_2x"))
```
